source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the exercise (PDF 223-225), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text:
1. Entrepreneurship ka asal maqsad (main goal) kya hai?
a) Nayi technologies banana
b) Masle hal karna aur value (qadr) paida karna
c) Paisa (finances) sambhalna
d) Bari companies se muqabla karna

2. In mein se Design Thinking ka principle (usool) kaunsa hai?
a) Profit par tawajjo
b) Human-centered approach (insan ki zaroorat ko sab se aage rakhna)
c) Risks (khatre) kam karna
d) Thore waqt ke faidon par zor

3. Business plan banane ka pehla qadam kya hai?
a) Financial forecasting (aage ke paise ka andaza)
b) Market analysis
c) Business idea tay karna
d) Sales ke targets rakhna

4. Design Thinking mein aam taur par kaunsi technique istemal hoti hai?
a) SWOT Analysis
b) Brainstorming (zyada se zyada ideas sochna)
c) Lean manufacturing
d) Data mining

5. Market insights jama karne ka maqsad kya hai?
a) Products ki qeemat tay karna
b) Customers ki zarooratein aur market ke trends samajhna
c) Tax ka hisab lagana
d) Inventory sambhalna

6. Kamyab business pitch kaisi honi chahiye?
a) Lambi aur detail wali
b) Clear and persuasive (saaf aur baat manwane wali)
c) Sirf apni zaati kamyabiyon ki baat
d) Sirf investors ke liye

7. Effective (achha asar karne wali) marketing ka aham hissa kya hai?
a) Zyada qeemat
b) Mazboot brand identity (pehchan)
c) Random (bina plan ke) ishtihar
d) Production ke kharche kam karna

8. Karobar ke financial concepts entrepreneurs ki kis cheez mein madad karte hain?
a) Tax se bachna
b) Resources (paisa, saaman, waqt) sambhalna aur karobar barhane ka plan banana
c) Kharcha barhana
d) Bari companies se muqabla

9. Karobar mein storytelling ke liye kaunsi skill sab se zaroori hai?
a) Technical expertise (maharat)
b) Emotional connection (jazbati rishta)
c) Jismani taqat
d) Bari maali investment

10. Karobar mein innovation asal mein kis bare mein hai?
a) Nayi technologies invent (ijad) karna
b) Existing (pehle se maujood) products aur processes (kaam ke tareeqon) ko behtar banana
c) Kaam ke kharche kam karna
d) Production ki raftar barhana
Pehle khud jawab sochein, phir neeche table se milayein. Har sawal ka jawab us topic ke lesson mein samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Multiple choice ke jawab
rows: (b) masle hal karna, value paida karna
(b) customers ki zarooratein aur market trends
(b) resources sambhalna, karobar barhane ka plan
(b) existing products aur processes behtar karna

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein Unit 9 ki answer key das sawalon ke liye chaudah (14) jawab deti hai, aur sawal 2, 5, 9 aur 10 par us ka jawab chapter ke text se mel nahi khata. Table mein 'Text se jawab' wale jawab chapter ke apne text se liye gaye hain; yeh sawal teacher se bhi confirm kar lein.

items: Entrepreneurship ki apne alfaaz mein definition (matlab) likhiye. (Jawab: topic 9.1 ka lesson.)
Design Thinking ka main focus (asal tawajjo) kis par hota hai? (Jawab: topic 9.1.1 ka lesson.)
Business plan banane ke aham qadam likhiye. (Jawab: topic 9.2.2 ka lesson.)
Naye karobar ke liye market research kyun zaroori hai? (Jawab: topic 9.3 ka lesson.)
Business pitch ki ahmiyat samjhaiye. (Jawab: topic 9.3.5 ka lesson.)
Storytelling karobar ko kaise faida de sakti hai? (Jawab: topic 9.6.2 ka lesson.)
Karobar ke liye zaroori koi ek financial concept bayan kijiye. (Jawab: topic 9.5.2 ka lesson.)
Entrepreneurship ke process (amal) mein collaboration kyun zaroori hai? (Jawab: topic 9.7.1 ka lesson.)
Business solutions banane mein Design Thinking ki ahmiyat bataiye, aur misalon se dikhaiye ke ise kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai. (Jawab: topic 9.1.3 ka lesson.)
Business plan banane ka process samjhaiye, aur yeh ke naye karobar ki kamyabi ke liye har qadam kyun zaroori hai. (Jawab: topic 9.2.2 ka lesson.)
Market insight karobari faislon par kaise asar dalti hai? Misalein dijiye ke karobar yeh maloomat kaise istemal kar sakte hain. (Jawab: topic 9.3.2 ka lesson.)
Effective business pitch ke aham hisse bataiye aur yeh ke pitch kaise tayyar ki jati hai. (Jawab: topic 9.3.4 ka lesson.)
Marketing aur sales strategy ke zaroori hisse kya hain? Bataiye ke yeh strategies alag alag markets ke liye kaise badli ja sakti hain. (Jawab: topic 9.4.3 ka lesson.)
Karobar mein financial management (paise ka intezam) ki ahmiyat samjhaiye. Budgeting aur cash flow jaise concepts karobar ke kaam par kaise asar dalte hain? (Jawab: topic 9.5.3 ka lesson.)
Brand banane aur customers se jurne mein communication aur storytelling ka kirdar bataiye. (Jawab: topic 9.6.3 ka lesson.)
Collaboration aur iteration naye karobar ki kamyabi mein kaise hissa dalte hain? Misalein dijiye ke yeh dono asal mein kaise kaam karte hain. (Jawab: topic 9.7.3 ka lesson.)
Text se MCQ jawab: 1b 2b 3c 4b 5b 6b 7b 8b 9b 10b; chhapi hui key sawal 2, 5, 9 aur 10 par mukhtalif hai.
